title: Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 (10th edition; awards presented by President Droupadi Murmu at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi, Wed 11 Nov 2026): Navi Mumbai tops the Super Swachh League (for cities ranked in the top three in recent editions), ahead of Surat and Vijayawada, rising from third in 2024-25, when Indore led the league followed by Surat and Navi Mumbai. Indore is not in this year's top three, ending its run of eight surveys at the top (The Tribune, The Federal; PTI in 2025 reported its eighth straight win); Indore-Depalpur came second to Ahmedabad-Sanand in the new Swachh Shehar Jodi mentor-mentee category. Main ranking: Greater Visakhapatnam, Jabalpur and Lucknow lead cities of 10 lakh-plus; Ujjain, Chandigarh and Guntur lead 3-10 lakh. Special awards: coastal (Puri, Alappuzha, Ratnagiri), riverfront (Rewa, Bilaspur, Varanasi), Himalayan (Rudrapur, Jammu, Shopian). The survey ranked 4,751 cities on 43 indicators (ETV Bharat, ANI), up from 73 in 2016; India TV gave 4,909, so the figure is attributed.
